name: Yomitan (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Yomitan village emblem in yellow: a thin ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yomitan, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 December 1976.

features.role: Yomitan village emblem — a thin ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes
